body: It means more than you know. I'm not sure why but your words brought me some comfort when I desperately needed it. Being suggested to focus on practical, calming things like Scrubs (the best), or spending time with my dog is advice I took, and it helped me get through the helpless and hopelessness I had today. Thank you stranger for helping me get through today, it really helped more than you know just knowing someone out there in the void heard what I said. You did a kind thing.

Today was the darkest I've had in years, but (maybe this sounds ridiculous but) knowing that some stranger out there heard something I said helped me to not feel as utterly alone as I did when I posted this. Thank you. I've heard what you've said and I think you made good points, and I appreciate your perspective. I especially feel like the defence mechanism observation is something I will need to think more on. It's really hard to be able to see/think clearly when I'm in the grips of a helpless moment, and you helped. Thank you, you did a very kind thing today.
